plugins.name: greenflash
plugins.description: Analyze real user-agent conversations to surface where users get blocked, which flows fail, and what to change. Health checks, inbox triage, user insights, prompt optimization, and diagnostics.

skills.name: greenflash-diagnose
skills.description: Root cause analysis for silent failures your evals miss. Surfaces failing tools, guardrail violations, and user friction with concrete fixes. Can implement changes directly in your codebase.
headings: When the User Disagrees with the Diagnosis
skills.description_zh: 调查评估遗漏的静默失败根因，识别工具失败、规则违规和用户阻力，提出具体修复并可直接修改代码。

skills.name: greenflash-health
skills.description: Surface quality trends, anomalies, safety issues, and sentiment across your AI products. Use for health checks, status overviews, and monitoring what needs attention.
skills.description_zh: 汇总 AI 产品质量趋势、异常、安全问题和情绪，用于健康检查和待处理事项监控。

skills.name: greenflash-inbox
skills.description: Triage flagged conversations prioritized by severity. Surfaces interactions needing human attention — guardrail violations, quality issues, and safety flags.
skills.description_zh: 按严重程度分诊标记对话，找出需要人工关注的规则违规、质量和安全问题。

skills.name: greenflash-onboard-agentic
skills.description: Log structured message types for agentic workflows: tool calls, reasoning traces, and multi-step chains. Upgrades an existing Greenflash integration with richer agent visibility.
skills.description_zh: 为已有 Greenflash 集成增加结构化工具调用、推理轨迹和多步骤链路消息记录，提高代理工作流可见性。

skills.name: greenflash-onboard-events
skills.description: Track business events and link AI conversations to real outcomes like conversions, upgrades, and churn. Upgrades an existing Greenflash integration with outcome attribution.
skills.description_zh: 为已有 Greenflash 集成跟踪业务事件，将 AI 对话关联转化、升级和流失等实际结果。

skills.name: greenflash-onboard-prompts
skills.description: Log system prompts for automatic versioning and component-level optimization. Upgrades an existing Greenflash integration with prompt tracking and analytics.
headings: Option B: Structured Prompt with Components
skills.description_zh: 记录系统提示以自动版本化和组件级优化，为已有 Greenflash 集成增加提示跟踪分析。

skills.name: greenflash-onboard-unified
skills.description: One-command Greenflash setup. Auto-detects your codebase and walks through SDK installation, conversation logging, prompt tracking, agentic messages, and event tracking in one guided flow.
skills.description_zh: 自动识别代码库，单一引导流程完成 Greenflash SDK、对话记录、提示跟踪、代理消息与业务事件接入。

skills.name: greenflash-onboard
skills.description: Low-level SDK install and conversation logging only. Most users should use greenflash-onboard-unified instead — it auto-detects the codebase and runs the full guided setup, delegating to this skill for the SDK step. Use this directly only when you specifically want JUST conversation logging set up, with no prompts/agentic/events tracking.
headings: Step 4: Analyze the codebase for logging pattern
skills.description_zh: 仅安装 Greenflash 底层 SDK 和对话日志；完整自动识别设置使用 onboard-unified，直接调用适用于无需提示、代理或事件跟踪的情况。

skills.name: greenflash-prompts
skills.description: Find prompt and model quality issues using real conversation data, with specific optimization recommendations. Can implement prompt fixes and model switches directly in your codebase.
skills.description_zh: 从真实对话发现提示与模型质量问题，提出具体优化，并可直接在代码中修复提示或切换模型。

skills.name: greenflash-tickets
skills.description: Draft and file tickets in Linear (or your connected ticket provider) directly from Greenflash conversation evidence. Two-step draft → confirm flow with editable title, description, and labels.
skills.description_zh: 依据 Greenflash 对话证据起草并提交 Linear 或已连接工单系统的票据，先草稿后确认，可编辑标题、描述和标签。

skills.name: greenflash-update-context
skills.description: Update a Greenflash product's context notes when an analysis is wrong or incomplete. Use when the user says "Greenflash got this wrong", "fix this analysis", "update product context", "add context to my product", "tell Greenflash that X", or wants to correct a sentiment/frustration/quality call. Forwards the user's exact correction to the product context update endpoint, which intelligently merges it into the product's optimization notes.
headings: When NOT to Use — Refuse and Redirect
skills.description_zh: 在 Greenflash 分析错误或不完整时将用户原样更正提交到产品上下文更新端点，合并进优化备注，用于修正情绪、挫折或质量判断。

skills.name: greenflash-users
skills.description: Understand user behavior from real conversations. Individual lookups, segment health, cohort analysis, and custom segment creation. Identifies frustrated, churning, or high-value users.
skills.description_zh: 根据真实对话分析用户行为，支持个体查询、分群健康、队列分析和自定义分群，识别挫折、流失或高价值用户。

skills.name: greenflash-verify
skills.description: Verify your Greenflash integration is working: API key, products, SDK installation, client setup, message logging, and data flow. Run after onboarding or to confirm setup health.
skills.description_zh: 在接入后验证 Greenflash API 密钥、产品、SDK、客户端、消息日志与数据流，确认集成健康。

skills.name: greenflash
skills.description: Entry point for all Greenflash queries. Analyzes real user-agent conversations to surface blockers, failures, and engagement drivers. Auto-detects SDK setup and offers onboarding. Routes to specialized sub-skills based on intent.
skills.description_zh: 作为 Greenflash 查询入口，从真实用户与代理对话发现阻塞、失败和参与驱动因素，识别 SDK 设置并提供接入引导，按意图路由专用技能。
